conclusion: The accepted-step stopping predicate can stop before the recorded unrestricted correction meets the native certificate. The final native certificate correctly withholds these results. The analytic contract check does not prove that changing this predicate will converge the real atmospheres.
next_bounded_test: Evaluate the unrestricted-temperature convergence predicate on a saved failed atmosphere under unchanged equations and tolerances before any cold scientific retry. Keep domain, grid-order and unfinished-timeout branches separate.
